messages:
maria: Hey team — quick heads-up. I need to swap my Fri 16:00 UTC release slot (canary + main) with someone later in the day. I own the model-routing change (weight shift + feature flag). No DB migrations. Rollback is a config flip, smoke is standard. If nobody can take 16:00 I can still run it but would rather swap so I can be available for the other team's demo at 17:00. @kevin @sam @carmen
kevin: What does the smoke look like? How long is the canary window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: Canary 30m, full 60m. Smoke checklist (condensed):
- verify 5 example prompts against control
- check latency p90 < 250ms
- embedding/cli key paths sanity
- no increased error rate in 15m window
Snippet: ```# smoke run commands
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'
redwood monitor metrics --range=15m --filter=errors,latency
```
sam: I can take the 18:30 UTC slot if that helps — I was planning a small infra change but can push. If maria takes 18:30 -> 19:30 demo safe?
maria: 18:30 works for me. Thanks! Can we mark the trade here so release-train has visibility?
carmen: tagging release-train roster @release-train — swapped: maria -> 18:30 UTC, sam -> 16:00 UTC (canary 30m). Please record in the sheet.
deploy-bot: slot_reservation: slot_id=6903 owner=sam window=2026-03-18T16:00:00Z status=reserved
kevin: Quick checklist for sam: please ensure canary uses routing 10% and has KV cache warmers. If you need an automatic rollback policy, set `policy=auto-failover:2m` else manual.
sam: Got it. I'll set `auto-failover:off` and monitor manually. Plan: canary at 16:00-16:30, full 16:45-17:45. I'll run the smoke steps and ping here when canary is green.
maria: FYI ops contact during canary: @kevin. Rollback command if needed: ```sh
redwood deploy rollback --release maria-routing-v3 --reason "canary errors"
```
carmen: I'll update the sheet and add a quick note in the train doc about this handoff. Also leave a runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/release-runbook#smoke-checks
kevin: One more ask — sam, when you start canary, post the metrics snapshot (errors, p95 latency, token rate). We want baseline vs canary. :white_check_mark:
sam: Will do. I'll post snapshots at T+5m and T+25m. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback and ping infra channel.
deploy-bot: deploy_plan_created: plan_id=pln-8473 owners=[sam] canary=30m full=60m predicted_risk=low
maria: Thanks all. If release-train leads need sign-off, I'm happy to post the final runbook and test prompts here ~15m before canary.
kevin: Good plan. Marking as acknowledged. :thumbsup:
